{{Top|leg}}
'''Zero-G mini-speeder go-cart steeplechase''' was a sporting competition. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the crews of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Unidentified Alliance corvette|corvette]] and an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Rebel Alliance corvette)|Star Destroyer]] were captured by a group of [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Unidentified googly-eyed species|aliens]]. They had observed the [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]] between the two [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and misinterpreted it as a sports contest. However, the alien [[Species/Legends|species]] prized fairness in all competitions and intervened due to the uneven nature of the contest. Taking the crews aboard their [[fathership]], the aliens graciously allowed them to continue their contest for their own entertainment while acting as judges. Zero-G mini-speeder go-cart steeplechase was one of a number of competitions that the aliens proposed for the crews to compete in, along with [[free-style zero-G swimming]], [[acrobatic pyramids]], marksmanship, and [[loudest-howling]].<ref name="Night">{{WEGCite|story=The Night Has a Thousand Eyes|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
